items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I saw Cozy Cole, and he said Raymond Scott needs a drummer.

ctx.x: Well, in his drum shop, we were just discussing, he knew where he was, being there with Cozy Cole, God bless him -- but he had one of the biggest cymbals I ever saw in my life; it was a Chinese cymbal, it was 24 to 25 inches. Now this was just about in the Artie Shaw days, and I had to have that cymbal. We did that record date which I'm going back to, 'Begin the Beguine,' and one of the songs on that date was 'Back Bay Shuffle,' which was a castoff of Chick Webb -- he tried it at rehearsal, but Chick had a…
